selected_entries.summary: Preserves inventory-as-evidence, ontology-as-map, and authority-as-decision while routing candidate meaning through owner gates.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Shapes the evidence, ontology, and promotion split for every candidate closure relation.
selected_entries.lane_effect: The formal-ontology explorer must model evidence and authority as distinct nodes and relations rather than treating a clear receipt as promotion.

selected_entries.summary: Selects a finite candidate-graph validator, named-policy evaluator, immutable receipts, and write isolation as the smallest defensible ontology prototype shape.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Seeds the minimum executable witness and non-vacuity requirements.
selected_entries.lane_effect: The non-vacuity reviewer must require a finite multi-artifact graph, named policy profiles, false-clear mutants, immutable receipts, and tested no-write behavior.

selected_entries.summary: Moves deterministic admission checks into a non-authoritative readiness projection while preserving execution and lifecycle owners.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Provides the closest local readiness-projection precedent.
selected_entries.lane_effect: The lifecycle explorer must distinguish a computed readiness projection from the validators and owners that establish its inputs.

selected_entries.summary: Operational Ontology was demoted into typed-ontology obligations plus lifecycle-axis obligations unless concrete operational obligations are named.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Guards against declaring one new universal Operational Ontology primitive.
selected_entries.lane_effect: The definitional skeptic must test whether Ontological Way Clear is a new behavior or merely a renamed D19/D23 projection.

selected_entries.summary: The governed-artifact primitive collapsed into existing definitions and lifecycle owners; view models are not authority and UX lessons remain local.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Supplies a typed negative against collapsing every requested artifact into one universal kind.
selected_entries.lane_effect: The synthesis must use artifact-kind profiles over shared primitives, not a single governed-artifact completeness checklist.

selected_entries.summary: Definition remains cataloging while invariants and routed pointers retain distinct semantic shapes and owners.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Prevents definitions, criteria, requirements, and invariants from being treated as interchangeable statement nodes.
selected_entries.lane_effect: The ontology explorer must preserve statement-kind and owner distinctions even when all participate in one closure query.

selected_entries.summary: Separates deterministic interface evidence, screenshot review, human study, and uncalibrated cross-project reuse.
selected_entries.obligation_fit: Constrains UX-plan closure so browser proxies cannot masquerade as human-comprehension evidence.
selected_entries.lane_effect: The architecture/UX explorer must model evidence classes and explicit human-study residue in the UX closure profile.

excluded_matches.reason: Useful explanation material, but it does not own readiness, closure profiles, or transition admission.
Owns a specific OEW integration-order decision, not the cross-artifact ontology requested here.

unresolved_gaps: The completed Way Clear decision-frontier experiment is not yet represented by a current Inventory entry; the dispatch must inspect its live public artifacts directly.
No indexed source currently defines one cross-artifact closure ontology spanning definitions, criteria, requirements, DoDs, architecture, designs, and UX plans.
The boundary between open-world ontology knowledge and closed-world transition admission remains unresolved.
No current finite witness proves reason-complete closure across all seven artifact families.
No current owner has approved Ontological Way Clear as a canonical term, relation set, capability, or promotion rule.
design_consequences: Use three explorer lanes: formal ontology, lifecycle and acceptance semantics, and architecture/design/UX evidence.
Use artifact-kind-specific ClosureProfiles over a shared obligation/evidence/dependency substrate; reject one universal checklist.
Require exact-binding evidence closure and a finite seven-family witness with false-clear and false-block mutants.
Keep evidence validation upstream of the Way Clear projection and keep promotion authority downstream with existing owners.
Retain explicit open-world versus declared-closed-world scope as a first-class research question.
non_authority_notice: This packet is a read-only Inventory projection. It selects discovery leads and gaps but does not prove the research answer, validate the live Way Clear implementation, define ontology meaning, authorize a dispatch, satisfy check-tension, confirm execution, or promote any artifact.
